evidence.quotation: There were no prisons, no slums, no insane asylums, no cripples, no poverty, no wars.
evidence.paraphrase: description of societal changes eliminating various social problems

evidence.quotation: All diseases were conquered. So was old age.
evidence.paraphrase: explanation that disease and aging have been eliminated by technology

evidence.quotation: "A drupelet, Mr. Wehling, is one of the little knobs, one of the little pulpy grains of a blackberry," said Dr. Hitz. "Without population control, human beings would now be packed on this surface of this old planet like drupelets on a blackberry! Think of it!"
evidence.paraphrase: explanation of potential overcrowding if no population control

evidence.quotation: Wehling shot Dr. Hitz dead. "There's room for one--a great big one," he said.
evidence.paraphrase: violent act resulting in death of Dr Hitz

evidence.quotation: The painter sat on the top of his stepladder, looking down reflectively on the sorry scene.
"Looks so real," he said, "I can practically imagine I'm standing in the middle of it."
evidence.paraphrase: observer's perception contrasting art with reality
